purpose: Mechanism-corrected specification fixed before inspecting any ETH/UCY outcome
development_informed_by: the post-review Juelich/Tordeux unidirectional and bottleneck audit
calibration_runs: The seven complete bidirectional-corridor runs already assigned to calibration
graph_selection: Width 48 and 25 epochs minimized mean leave-one-complete-run-out calibration RMSE in a six-candidate capacity/epoch sweep
fallback_expert: anchored coarse HGB with no prospective-geometry features
guard_scope: per pedestrian with a causal five-observation rolling mean
signal_combination: one-sided exponential shrinkage only above the calibration envelope
threshold_rule: finite-sample 90% upper quantile of out-of-fold calibration scores
nominal_graph_weight_rule: one in support; the guard never alters a graph prediction below threshold
reporting: no cluster bootstrap intervals when fewer than ten runs are available
